newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end lower, erase recent gains.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end lower, erase recent gains.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures finished weaker as the spot-May contract erased some of its recent gains in an otherwise featureless session, floor sources said.
They blamed losses on speculative selling and a dearth of buying, which allowed the May contract to sink under its previous upside target of 85.00 cents.
The contract closed at 84.95, down 0.65, having ranged from 86.90 to 84.40 cents. The back months settled 0.20 to 1.80 weaker.
Prices remained in their recent range. Volume was estimated at 4,000 lots compared to Tuesday's official 2,067 lots.
A dearth of news could keep the market tone dull in the near term while the overall fundamental situation could slowly erode gains in the longer-term, market sources said.
Players await the weekly movement figures released after Thursday's close.
